changes.comment: New JsonSchema.record(values) factory (a map whose every value matches a schema; emits additionalProperties: <schema>), and JsonSchema.fromJson accepts a schema-valued additionalProperties as a record when no properties are declared and no keyword constraining its key set accompanies it (patternProperties, propertyNames, unevaluatedProperties, dependentRequired, dependentSchemas, dependencies, minProperties, maxProperties); an annotation-only additionalProperties ({}) now means the same as true. Numeric enums and schemas with no type ({}) are still refused, now with their own messages; pattern stays refused.
